# Registry snapshots

relgap maps a tool name to its GitHub repository with copies of two registries that ship inside
the binary. Both registries are MIT-licensed, and relgap keeps their license texts with the copies.

| Registry | Source | Commit | Commit date | Entries |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| mise | [jdx/mise](https://github.com/jdx/mise) | [`8fa03c478931`](https://github.com/jdx/mise/commit/8fa03c4789317cdc08dd72420979729ce4a69b79) | 2026-11-09T10:34:37-06:00 | 1022 |
| aqua | [aquaproj/aqua-registry](https://github.com/aquaproj/aqua-registry) | [`a790da1b9e44`](https://github.com/aquaproj/aqua-registry/commit/a790da1b9e44147ba393351d3e60ec8d5a5d33d7) | 2026-11-09T16:23:13Z | 2351 |

When mise is on `PATH`, relgap reads `mise registry --json` instead of the mise copy, so the
registry matches the mise you run. The aqua copy is always the embedded one. This page describes
the copies in the latest release.
